label: Opening Hook
text: A 1,600-year-old Roman cup glows green in reflected light and turns red when lit from behind.
title: File:Top view of the famed Lycurgus Cup in the British Museum, showing the glass both green and ruby red.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: 4th-century AD Roman glass cage cup, now in the British Museum The colour change comes from tiny gold and silver nanoparticles in the glass It depicts the myth of King Lycurgus Its makers probably did not understand the effect in modern terms It has inspired modern research into nanoparticle optics
title: File:Front of 4th century CE Roman Lycurgus Cup, British Museum (1958,1202.1).jpg
